tagline: A diversified financial holding company providing banking, broker-dealer, and mortgage origination services across the United States
hero_kpi_rationale: Remarkable 46.2% growth in net income in 2025, driven by a significant decrease in provision for credit losses, reflecting improved loan portfolio quality and the operational strength of the financial holding company.

kpis.name: Net Income Attributable to Hilltop
kpis.explanation: Net income after taxes attributable to the company shareholders.
kpis.description: Net income attributable increased nearly 46% in 2025, driven by a decrease in provision for credit losses.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.explanation: Total value of assets held by the company, including loans, securities, and cash.
kpis.description: Total assets decreased 2.6% compared to 2024, reflecting prudent balance sheet management.

kpis.name: Total Deposits
kpis.explanation: Total amount of customer deposits held by the bank.
kpis.description: Deposits slightly declined in 2025, remaining close to 2024 levels.

kpis.name: Provision for Credit Losses
kpis.explanation: Amount set aside to cover potential losses on loans.
kpis.description: Provision declined 92%, indicating improved credit portfolio quality.

kpis.name: Net Interest Income
kpis.explanation: Difference between interest revenue received and interest expense paid.
kpis.description: Net interest income increased due to a high interest rate environment.

kpis.name: Tangible Book Value per Share
kpis.explanation: Adjusted book value of net assets per share, excluding goodwill.
kpis.description: Tangible book value per share advanced 7.9% in 2025.

kpis.name: Dividend Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Portion of earnings distributed as dividends.
kpis.description: Dividend payout ratio decreased to 27.26% in 2025, allowing better profit reinvestment.

kpis.name: Share Repurchases
kpis.description: The company significantly increased share repurchases in 2025, totaling $184 million compared to $19.9 million in 2024.

kpis.name: Banking Segment Income Before Taxes
kpis.explanation: Banking segment contribution to consolidated income before taxes.
kpis.description: The banking segment contributed $193.2 million to income before taxes in 2025.

kpis.name: Mortgage Origination Segment Loss
kpis.explanation: Income before taxes loss from mortgage origination segment (PrimeLending).
kpis.description: The PrimeLending segment recorded a $17.5 million loss in 2025, reflecting mortgage market challenges.
kpis.signal: Persistent and significant mortgage segment loss
